description: Somos un equipo apasionado por la ciencia, la tecnología y la exploración espacial. A través de este proyecto buscamos contar las historias de los equipos que permanecen en la Luna y Marte, destacando sus descubrimientos, su legado y cómo contribuyeron a ampliar nuestro conocimiento del universo.
summary:
The Space Heritage Museum is an interactive educational website that tells the stories of human-made objects left behind on the Moon and Mars. Our project transforms space exploration history into an engaging museum experience for children, teenagers, and educators.
Visitors can explore space artifacts, discover important missions, follow an interactive timeline, play educational activities, and access learning resources. The website includes different experiences for each age group, helping users understand what these objects are, why they were left behind, and what they teach us about space exploration. AFTERLIGHT addresses the challenge by preserving the stories and cientific value of these forgotten objects through digital storytelling and education. Our goal is to inspire curiosity, make space heritage accessible, and remind everyone that even when a mission ends, its legacy remains.
details:
AFTERLIGHT is an interactive digital museum designed to preserve and share the stories of space exploration artifacts left behind on the Moon and Mars. The website organizes information about these objects into an educational experience that visitors can explore at their own pace.

The project includes three main learning experiences. Little Explorers introduces younger children to space through interactive games, stories, and activities. The Next Generation offers teenagers an educational game called SPACE QUEST: THE SCIENTIST'S JOURNEY, where they experience the process of becoming a space scientist and designing their own space artifact. The Educators Hub provides presentations, educational documents, classroom activities, and lesson resources for teachers.

The Space Heritage Gallery presents examples of space exploration hardware, while an interactive timeline helps visitors discover important missions throughout history. The website also connects users with educational resources and original NASA information.

AFTERLIGHT supports learning by making space history more accessible, engaging, and understandable for different age groups. It encourages curiosity, scientific thinking, and appreciation for the technology that helped humanity explore other worlds.

The project was planned as a responsive website with interactive navigation, embedded educational experiences, presentations, and PDF resources. Its design uses a futuristic museum style inspired by space exploration, with dark backgrounds, blue accents, and space imagery. The main goal is to show that even when a mission ends, the knowledge and history it leaves behind continue to matter.
